# NSIS build tool archive

`nsis-3.12.zip` is the unmodified official NSIS 3.12 binary distribution, retained here because download mirrors returned HTML or access errors on hosted Windows builds. It is a build dependency only and is not copied into the installed payload.

- Source: https://sourceforge.net/projects/nsis/files/NSIS%203/3.12/nsis-3.12.zip/download
- Size: 2,362,938 bytes
- SHA-256: `56581f90db321581c5381193d796fffcf2d24b2f8fed2160a6c6a3baa67f2c4f`
- The archive includes upstream license and copyright notices in its COPYING file and documentation. Preserve these when redistributing it. NSIS's license does not replace this project's MIT license.

The workflow verifies this hash before extracting or running the compiler. Do not replace the archive or hash without checking the upstream distribution.
